recommended_phases.name: Utilities and configuration
recommended_phases.rule: Only small low-risk helpers with no database, PDF, payment, balance, authentication, or Tkinter ownership dependencies.

recommended_phases.name: Report generators
recommended_phases.rule: Extract one report at a time and compare generated output before and after.

recommended_phases.name: UI tabs
recommended_phases.rule: Move one complete tab at a time while preserving callback signatures.

recommended_phases.name: Business and database services
recommended_phases.rule: Move only after calculation and database regression tests exist.
